task_text: Plate catch, transport and release: A ball is tossed up next to the robot when the episode starts. Catch it on the flat, rimless plate the Panda holds, settle it at the plate's centre, carry it through two waypoints (a turn) without letting it roll off, settle it again, then tip it off the plate into a basin that slides back and forth along a rail, where it must come to rest while the basin is moving. Phases, in order: airborne_plate_catch: the ball has flown free (touching nothing) for more than 0.05 s and then touches the plate.; recenter: the ball rests on the plate (in contact within the last 25 ms; in the plate's frame its centre is at least 2.5 cm inside every edge and between radius - 4 mm and radius + 15 mm above the top surface), within 3.5 cm of the plate's centre, moving at less than 0.08 m/s relative to the plate, for 0.3 s without interruption.; turning_transport: with the ball resting on the plate, the plate's centre (the tool frame) comes within 2.5 cm of waypoint A = (0.00, 0.08, 0.27), then within 2.5 cm of waypoint B = (0.18, 0.13, 0.25), in this order.; rolling_recovery: the ball rests on the plate within 3.5 cm of its centre, moving at less than 0.04 m/s relative to the plate, for 0.4 s without interruption.; moving_basin_release: the ball is inside the basin (its centre at least 0.45 x radius inside the basin's inner walls, resting on the basin, below its rim, moving at less than 0.09 m/s relative to the basin), not touching the plate, while the basin moves at more than 0.02 m/s, for 0.7 s without interruption. This completes the task. Goal geometry: Waypoint A (0.00, 0.08, 0.27) and waypoint B (0.18, 0.13, 0.25), for the plate's centre.
